blurb: Berwick Golf Club offers a challenging 18-hole championship golf course set along the Susquehanna River valley. The club provides various membership options including Platinum, Gold, Junior, Social, and Corporate memberships. Dining options include casual deck dining, elegant plated dinners, buffets, and banquet event hosting for weddings, corporate events, and parties.
